title: Spatial Transcriptomic and Proteomic Analysis Identifies Novel Immune-Associated Biomarkers of Anti-PD1 Response in Metastatic Melanoma.
snippet: Resistance to anti-PD1 therapy remains a major challenge in metastatic melanoma, despite long-term benefit in some patients. Since a functional dendritic cell (DC)-CD8T cell axis is essential for anti-PD1 response, biomarkers associated with this axis may help characterize underexplored immune states linked to resistance.
